Sergey Anosov (University of California at Berkeley)
Abstract: The problem we study is the derivation of a spectrum of eigenvalues for almost-periodic Schr\"{o}dinger operators related to a non-dynamical Schrödinger operator and some other periodic ones. We start from a spectral projection defined by the corresponding Dirac sequence and we derive a spectrum of the initial system. We develop a systematic and flexible tool for solving this problem. This class of quasicrystals allows to unify many known spectral facts for quasicrystalline Hamiltonians and for other examples related to quasiperoidicity. It opens a new approach to spectral geometry and also yields interesting relations between classical and quantum systems.
